surfaces.name: documentation-atlas
surfaces.weldRationale: Buildchain attests exact bytes while Xinfa remains the documentation compiler authority.

impactProjection.breaking: root mismatch or missing packaged bytes rejects the old passport
impactProjection.additive: successor Atlas requires a successor witness and passport
impactProjection.none: byte-identical artifact retains the declared root
impactProjection.unclassifiable: fail closed pending a new Xinfa qualification
